title: 自然语言 UI 请求应解析为可组合 Pattern Plan，而不是强迫单一 Pattern 胜出
summary: 复杂 UI 请求通常同时包含布局、控制层级、作用域、绑定、发现等多个语义。Foundry 的检索层应返回一组有证据的 Pattern，并用显式 Composition Recipe/Relation 描述它们能否组合、各自角色、实现与证据缺口。
principles: One user request may resolve to multiple orthogonal Patterns.
Pattern selection and composition compatibility are separate decisions.
Composition Recipes declare required/recommended/optional members and invariants.
A plan must surface missing realization/showcase/validation evidence.
Composition never changes member Pattern maturity.
